text: I'm getting braces from a male dentist, and he's constantly late. He's always complaining about traffic, being on his way, or his car breaking down. It's been a year, and there are constant problems. Why even say he starts work at 1 PM if …

Terrible experience. My boyfriend had an appointment to get lower braces fitted, and the staff told him to arrive no later than 4 PM. He arrived before 4 PM, but the staff said the dentist who was supposed to fit the braces had already …

I had braces here for 5 years, sometimes pulling to the left, sometimes to the right. When it was time to remove them, it ended up being pulled to the left. In short, my teeth are crooked. Now I'm in my second round of braces, but the waiting list is very long and it's very chaotic.

Long wait times, slow doctor, chaotic scheduling. They keep calling to remind you about appointments and say there's a penalty for lateness. Then, at the scheduled time, you sit and wait for 4-5 hours. Terrible service. The counter staff couldn't answer any questions. No wonder they're losing customers.

Complaint about service at The Mall Bangkapi branch.
March 4, 2018, I saw a promotion for teeth whitening for 2,999 baht. I asked to inquire. The staff refused to make an appointment and told me to call another …

I've had braces for a year and a half, and two of my tooth roots have died. The dentist won't take responsibility. During my visits, the dentist never talks to me or asks about my problems, and the waiting time is incredibly long every time.

Today I went in to inquire about booking a dental appointment. The staff looked at me like I didn't have the money to pay. They told me to come and consult about the appointment date when I wanted to proceed, and that I should come on that day. Their attitude was very rude.

The scaling procedure resulted in excessive bleeding, causing gums to swell and become red around the tooth base. Even after about two hours, I can still feel and smell bleeding, something that never happened at other clinics before.
It's terrible. Every time I come to get it done, I have to wait 3-4 hours. I made an appointment at 3 PM and it's always almost 7 PM before it's finished.
